The '''Ore Processor''' is an early-game workshop, requiring only mechanisms and blocks to build. It is the start of early metal industry, processing Ore-Bearing [[rock]] into pure [[ore]]. Ore-bearing rock, when mined, is very inefficient for smelting, having very low [[metal]] production rates. After refining into pure ore, the rates become more decent, with metal guaranteed at smelting.
